disclosure: Test results of the baseline are already known. Two of the candidate ideas were suggested by earlier analyses that used test labels: the ELBO score (test AP 0.450 vs 0.432 for reconstruction error) and feature-wise normalisation (V27 dominates the fraud reconstruction error on test). Candidates suggested by test observations may look optimistic on the test set. Mitigation: the candidate list is fixed in configs/model_selection.yaml before any validation result is computed, selection uses validation data only, and the test set is evaluated once afterwards.
